narrative.title: The Wildcard Ledger Reconciliation
narrative.scenario: A reconciliation script parses ledger lines containing opens, closes, and wildcard tokens that may act as either — or vanish entirely. A line is acceptable if some assignment of the wildcards makes the brackets balance in order. The auditor tracks the lowest and highest plausible open-count while scanning, and accepts the line only if zero opens remains reachable at the end.
narrative.inputFormat: A string s containing only '(', ')' and '*'.
narrative.outputFormat: Return true if s can be a valid parenthesis sequence under some wildcard assignment.

testCases.explanation: The wildcard plays the opener, matching the two closers that follow.
Here the wildcard acts as the closer.

hintLevels: Level 1: Instead of trying assignments, track the interval of achievable open-counts.
Level 2: '(' shifts the interval up; ')' shifts it down; '*' widens it by one on both ends.
Level 3: Clamp the low end at 0 (wildcards can vanish) and fail only when even the high end goes negative.
